1445-2511-4871-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2511-4871-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2707-4377-5496.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

3490-5295-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-5295-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

522-5147--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

856-2173-4247-5220.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-2173-4247-5220.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-2173-4247-5220.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

5571-6495-7310--6.description:
Use Kitsune to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
5571-6495-7310--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-4247-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4247-5789.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1315-5621-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Repeat.

877-997-3081-3817.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

141-7694.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Multiversal Incursion
Resolve the copy of Multiversal Incursion, creating a token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

891-2034-2730.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

2511-3817-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

967-3670-4166-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Ingenious Artillerist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, and exiling Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile until your end step.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5315-6972-7156.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

2653-2692-2893-5478.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

567-3490-4017-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-3490-4017-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-2905-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Tormod's Crypt.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Pestermite.
When Pestermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

222-527-1115-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1115-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1069-1232-5499-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-5499-6791.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

252-2073-4050--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4733-6242.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Legate Lanius triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat until no opponent controls a creature.
2034-3490-4733-6242.notes: You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponents control, using the Servo generated from the last iteration.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3719-3734-5326.notablePrerequisites: Phyrexian Metamorph has a power of at least 2.
2713-3719-3734-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Phyrexian Metamorph and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Phyrexian Metamorph to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Phyrexian Metamorph by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2525-4050-6132.description:
Cast Metamorphosis Fanatic by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Body Double, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-5485.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
1115-3259-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

575-997-4319-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-997-4319-5441.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Granite Witness.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

658-1453-2200-4438-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Urza's Saga has two lore counters on it.
Lands you control except Urza's Saga can tap to produce at least {2}.
Your life total is at least 11.
The number of artifacts you control plus Arwen's toughness is equal to or greater than 9.
658-1453-2200-4438-4613.description:
Activate any number of lands except Urza's Saga by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Urza's Saga's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control, and that enters the battlefield with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Arwen's toughness.
Activate the Construct using Beledros Witherbloom's ability by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Diamond Valley by tapping it and sacrificing the Construct, causing you to gain at least 10 life.
Repeat.
If the number of artifacts you control plus Arwen's toughness is equal to or greater than 10, this combo nets infinite life, and if other lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.
If you get infinite life and infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Constructs.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

4089-5011-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1987-2493-3830.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Archaeomancer and the Island.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1171-1369-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Quicksilver Elemental.
1171-1369-3525.description:
Activate Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, targeting Garth One-Eye.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat for infinite blue mana.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, targeting Garth One-Eye.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Repeat for infinite colored mana.

1949-2521-2836.notablePrerequisites:
No other creatures in library.
You control fewer creatures than than target player.
1949-2521-2836.description:
During the upkeep, Oath of Druids will trigger twice.
First you mill into Laboratory Maniac and put it on the battlefield.
Then mill your entire library, draw a card for turn and win.

364-1987-4125-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
